widgets_values: A cinematic continuous video using the same main subject from the reference image, consistent identity, consistent outfit, natural camera motion, coherent lighting, realistic motion, stable temporal consistency.

The camera zooms toward the eagle's eye as it flies. Inside the pupil, a cyberpunk city is already visible, distorted by the curved surface of the eye. | Cars move close to the camera in layered traffic lanes inside the cyberpunk city. | The camera starts to track and lock onto one car. | The camera slowly zooms out and reveals that the cyberpunk city scene is playing on a television screen inside a 20th-century living room.

A cinematic 16: 9 vertical horror chase sequence at 24fps, following a terrified 21-year-old Chinese woman as she flees from zombies through an urban environment: starting on a dimly lit street, turning a narrow alley corner, bursting through shop doors, and finally running into a deserted car park at night. The subject has long straight black hair partially disheveled from running, fair porcelain skin with visible sweat and dirt smudges, wide fearful eyes, and wears a casual white oversized T-shirt with light blue ripped jeans and white sneakers — these visual anchors must remain 100% consistent across all shots with zero face morphing, outfit drift, or hairstyle changes. Lighting transitions from flickering streetlamp orange to cold neon shop signs to harsh fluorescent car park lights, creating dramatic high-contrast shadows. Camera style: authentic handheld selfie perspective for close-ups with subtle micro-shake and motion blur, transitioning to cinematic wide tracking shot for the final reveal. Mood: intense, suspenseful, breathless urgency.
